//: Thread view cases shared by dashboard/src/threadView.test.ts and ios/DevboxAppTests/ThreadStoreTests.swift. Each case starts from an empty thread and applies its steps in order: `event` (applyThreadEvent), `snapshot` (mergeSnapshot) or `notice` (applyNotice); `expect` is the resulting thread, `derived` the active, queued and critic runs.

cases.name: deltas then final: one assistant item, streaming until the final text replaces it
deltas only: the assistant item keeps streaming
duplicate seq ignored: the same event again changes nothing
request opened stays pending; a re-announcement is a no-op
request resolved updates the item and drops the pending request; expired has no output
tools: re-announced start is a no-op, finish fills output, a finish without start is an unknown tool
terminal events close streaming items; usage only from run.completed
run.failed keeps the usage, adds a notice and keeps a known failure reason
a later run.failed without a reason drops the old reason, an unknown reason is dropped, an unknown run is a notice

items.text: interrupted event for unknown run nope

cases.name: message.final from the user does not duplicate the queued text
unknown event type becomes a visible notice; bridge restart only when resumed
bridge.started with a notice (bridge 1.5.0+) shows it after the restart notice

event.notice: state.json was unusable; rebuilt from the log

items.text: state.json was unusable; rebuilt from the log

cases.name: bridge.notice (bridge 1.5.0+) is a notice in the thread
background.changed replaces the list; active and queued runs
mergeSnapshot: changed rows replace the client's copies, new ones append, the rest is wholesale
mergeSnapshot: a notice already applied from a live frame is not added twice
mergeSnapshot: lastSeq never goes back
the user item keeps its attachments, from run.queued or from the start echo
a run that starts at once has its user item
deltas after a run's terminal event are ignored: the item stays done
a devd notice is added once, after what is there, and leaves lastSeq alone; a snapshot carrying it adds nothing
resume-failed or open-failed for a run id never announced adds no item
a thread.native without a model keeps the harness's known model
a thread.native of another harness without a model has none
critic runs: started by the critic, or queued with origin critic
a start for a run that already ended is not a regression
